post_topic: Scope discipline as the core engineering skill when building solo while employed full-time
image_description:
Single standalone diagram. One concept only. No panels, no grids, no collages. Full bleed 1080x1080px white background.

A vertical flow diagram titled 'Scope Discipline: Team Design vs Solo Design' at the top in bold navy text.

On the LEFT side, a column labeled 'Team-Scoped Architecture' in blue (#5a96ff). Below it, four stacked boxes connected by downward arrows: 'Multi-tenant State Machine Router', 'Pluggable LLM Backend Layer', 'Full Audit Logging Pipeline', 'Custom Tenant Onboarding Flow'. A red bracket on the right side of this column with an amber (#F5A623) label reading '6-month backlog before first user'.

On the RIGHT side, a column labeled 'Solo-Scoped Architecture (Load-Bearing Bones)' in blue (#5a96ff). Below it, three stacked boxes connected by downward arrows, each with an amber left border callout: 'HITL Gate — intercepts before execution', 'LLM Router — swaps models, pipeline unchanged', 'Tenant Isolation — built to scale from day one'. Below these three boxes, a dashed-border box labeled 'Phase 2 (only if Phase 1 ships)' in gray.

A horizontal divider separates the two columns. In the center of the diagram between the columns, a navy diamond decision node labeled 'Can I support this alone at 5am before work?' with a YES arrow pointing to the right column and a NO arrow pointing away.

At the bottom of the diagram, a footer bar in navy with white text: 'Right-size the build for available hours — not the team you wish you had.'

Navy #0A0F1E primary elements, blue #5a96ff highlights, amber #F5A623 callouts and important labels. Clean sans-serif font. Real cloud provider logos where relevant. Small text 'Kelvin Davis' bottom right corner. Professional LinkedIn infographic style similar to ByteByteGo. White background. No dark backgrounds.
